svg.aria-label: Boyi Dai, Computer Engineering at the University of Virginia. Interests: systems, infrastructure, compilers. Built: an LLM inference engine, a tensor compiler, a SQL engine, an 8-bit CPU, an analog audio analyzer. Building: nanocompile, a tensor compiler for nanoinfer, phase 3 of 8. Languages: Python, Rust, C, C++, VHDL, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java. Tools: NumPy, WebGPU, Pyodide, Jupyter, FPGA (Cyclone V), KiCad, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL.
